source_snapshot.procedure: Issue OEM raw 0x30/0x23/0x02, inspect UID color, issue 0x30/0x23/0x00 and inspect again.
source_snapshot.criteria: UID blinks successfully and is OFF when turned off manually.
source_snapshot.script: Private UID_Blink_IB.sh; 10 attended and 10 machine minutes.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; proposes only the blink payload and human observation, assumes an undocumented readback and omits the source off action and restoration.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION at MEDIUM risk; validate blink/off contract, cadence and readback, capture baseline, obtain operator blink/off evidence, clarify manual-versus-command wording and restore baseline.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Correctly notes physical observation but does not execute or evidence the off step and lacks cadence, target and baseline controls.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly preserves the hybrid automation/manual boundary and makes timing/color/visibility a physical oracle rather than an exit-code inference.
historical_reviews.history: No earlier exact source identity record exists.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Blink is a temporal property: a single photo or logical mode bit cannot prove cadence, duty cycle or sustained visibility. Evidence needs a bounded observation interval and a final stable-off observation tied to the same chassis.

original_test_intent: Verify the approved BMC UID blink command produces the specified physical blinking behavior and that the indicator can be returned to off, then restore its original baseline state.
original_method: Verify exact BMC/chassis and vendor blink/off/readback contract; record baseline UID state; issue one approved blink transition; capture response/readback and operator video or timed checklist for color/cadence/visibility; issue the approved off transition; confirm logical and physical off; restore baseline if different and preserve logs.
manual_activity: The owner confirms blink cadence, final off action and raw contract; an authorized operator observes the physical indicator for the full interval, confirms final off and verifies baseline restoration.
required_inputs: Vendor blink/off command and response schema
Expected color, cadence, duty and observation duration
Meaning of manually turned off in Criteria
safety_requirements: Never guess OEM raw semantics or readback
Change one verified chassis UID only
Do not infer cadence from command success
Stop on wrong target or ambiguous LED response and never auto-retry unknown payloads
agent_execution_scope: Execute one blink then one approved off transition
Restore baseline and archive without verdict
engineer_actions: Confirm whether off is IPMI-command or separate manual action
Observe physical blink/color and final off

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The blink payload matches Procedure at a high level, but DeepSeek omits the mandatory off command, assumes zero-data readback and lacks cadence, baseline and protected-target controls.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After vendor/owner approval, issue one documented blink payload, observe the physical LED for the defined interval, issue the approved off action, confirm off through physical evidence and supported readback, then restore baseline.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The 10/10-minute blink-observe-off-observe sequence is preserved; missing cadence and final-action semantics are gated rather than inferred.

modernized_recommendation.status: TIMED PHYSICAL UID BLINK AND OFF VERIFICATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Record baseline, blink command/response, logical mode, timestamped video or cadence checklist, off action/response, stable-off observation and restored state against one chassis identity.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds temporal acceptance, vendor semantics, final-action clarification and complete lifecycle restoration.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A raw completion or still image cannot prove actual blinking, correct cadence or persistent off state.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Camera frame rate may alias the blink cadence; operator evidence should record an observation window and, where possible, timing measurements rather than one frame.

project_override_considerations: The Project must define blink color/cadence/duty and whether Criteria's manually turned off means the procedure's IPMI off command or a physical control. This ambiguity changes the last action but not the primary blink objective.
expected_evidence: Approval, exact target identity and vendor blink/off/readback contract
Baseline logical and physical UID state
Complete blink response/readback plus timed physical cadence/color evidence
Approved off action with response/readback and stable-off observation
Restored baseline and preserved log review

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, procedure and first criterion consistently target UID blink followed by off. Criteria's word `manually` makes the final off mechanism ambiguous, but it does not introduce a competing outcome; the Project must clarify the execution method.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Vendor semantics, cadence and final off method are obtainable project inputs. Execution becomes BLOCKED if physical blink/off cannot be observed or baseline restoration cannot be assured.

review_improvement: Adds the omitted off transition and a true temporal/physical blink oracle while preventing undocumented readback or a single still image from substituting for observed cadence.
independent_technical_reasoning: Blink mode can be latched logically even if the LED is failed, obstructed or wired to a different chassis. Conversely, a camera can sample a valid blink as steady on or off. The test needs a sufficiently long human observation or cadence-aware video and must correlate both transitions to the same labeled physical indicator and baseline state.
